responsibility: Provides the target-specific precision constants used when defining rs6000’s three 128-bit floating-point machine modes. Its main responsibility is establishing the relative ordering of IFmode, TFmode, and KFmode precisions so generic GCC widening logic treats IBM extended double, long double, and explicit IEEE quad in the intended priority order for PowerPC targets.
same_name_distinction: This is the support header in the rs6000-modes pair: it only defines FLOAT_PRECISION_IFmode/TFmode/KFmode ordering constants, whereas rs6000-modes.def uses them to declare the actual target-specific machine modes.
